# hyperfluid_agent_channel_limits (Resource)

The limits an agent applies to its audiences outside the console (the web widget, Matrix/Tchap, Slack, Discord): hourly and daily ceilings, the per-sender bucket, the question length and the concurrency. Each must be at least 1. A limit left out takes the runtime's default; every change sends all of them again. Destroying the resource resets the agent to the defaults. Limits reset outside Terraform leave the state. Imported by agent id. Needs the organization's `sapience_agent_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Shared by the web widget and the chat channels, counted apart for each.
resource "hyperfluid_agent_channel_limits" "this" {
  agent_id           = hyperfluid_agent.support.id
  questions_per_hour = 200
  questions_per_day  = 1000
  per_sender_burst   = 6
  max_concurrent     = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Id of the `hyperfluid_agent`. Changing this forces a new set of limits.

### Optional

- `max_concurrent` (Number) Questions the agent answers at the same time. Left out, the runtime's default.
- `max_question_length` (Number) Longest question from a chat channel, at most 4000 characters (the widget has its own). Left out, the runtime's default.
- `per_sender_burst` (Number) Questions one sender may ask in a burst. Left out, the runtime's default.
- `per_sender_refill_seconds` (Number) Seconds for one sender to earn one more question. Left out, the runtime's default.
- `questions_per_day` (Number) Questions the agent answers per day, per pool. Left out, the runtime's default.
- `questions_per_hour` (Number) Questions the agent answers per hour, per pool (the widget and the chat channels are counted apart). Left out, the runtime's default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The agent id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import id is the agent id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_agent_channel_limits.this 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
